scientific_integrity: Independent verification of mathematical novelty or priority has not occurred; the same-model proof inspection is not a claim of independent certification. Source comparisons include material from original graph MBO articles, the corrective sequel, and related nonlinear-dynamics literature.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted complete bipartite graphs; simple random-walk-normalized heat; binary values; threshold one-half with tie preservation; fixed positive diffusion time. Other graph families, weights, thresholds, and diffusion generators are not covered.
title: Two-step stabilization and sharp five-site onset in normalized bipartite heat thresholding
